command: set -u; echo '=== HOST ==='; hostname; date -Is; id -un; echo HOME=$HOME; echo '=== LOAD ==='; uptime; echo '=== FRANKENSTEIN REPO ==='; d="$HOME/frankenstein-repo"; if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then git -C "$d" status --short --branch; git -C "$d" log -12 --oneline --decorate; echo '--- recent changed files'; find "$d" -type f -mmin -2880 -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%TS %s %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -r | head -180; else echo missing:$d; fi; echo '=== AVATAR HANDOFF / PACKETS ==='; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -iname '*avatar*' -o -iname '*face*' -o -iname '*eye*' -o -iname '*body*' -o -iname '*animation*' -o -iname '*storyboard*' \) -mmin -2880 -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%TS %s %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -r | head -220; echo '=== LIVE PROCESSES ==='; ps -eo pid,lstart,pcpu,pmem,cmd --sort=-pcpu | grep -Ei 'claude|frank|avatar|python|node' | grep -v grep | head -100
